author: Unity
description:
The 2026 Official Unity Game Jam kicked off today!

Whether you’re a seasoned veteran, a student, or building your very first game, this is your time to shine.

📅 When: November 5th – 14th
📍 Where: Online via itch.io & the Unity Discord

What’s new this year? We’ve expanded the jam to a full 7 days to give you more build time, plus added The Buffer™ (extra time after the 7 days specifically to package, upload, and fix last-minute bugs without the deadline panic). We also added a Best Student Category designed specifically for those enrolled in educational institutions. 

Compete for awesome prizes like Unity Pro, Discord Nitro, Odin Inspector, and Photon Plus!

🔗 Register now: https://on.unity.com/UnityGameJam26
